item.title: Democrats sweep US midterms, winning control of both chambers of Congress
item.description: The Democratic Party has won majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the 2026 US midterm elections, dealing a historic setback to President Donald Trump and ending Republican control of Congress. item.description: Israel's president, Isaac Herzog, began consultations with political parties on Wednesday evening to determine who will be tasked with forming a new government, after official results from the 27 October parliamentary election confirmed an inconclusive outcome. item.title: CDC reportedly delays measles alert as New York reports first death in 30 years, Iowa confirms 50 cases
